claim_boundary: A pass would establish that a conservative visible-only continuation ensemble can recover correctly localized independent omission witnesses on six previously untouched PHerc0139 regions while rejecting frozen adjacent-winding controls. It would justify an experimental diagnostic, not whole-scroll completeness or target-scroll validity.

decision.interpretation: A pass promotes the polynomial-consensus method only to an experimental diagnostic and supports replication with a second independent witness family. It does not prove recto completeness.
